meta.description: Axiom Force - Character-Driven Campaign Narrative: three operative leads (Cyber Shogun, Oceanus, Aura Phoenicia) and the machine guide AXIOM-7

act1_fracturing_grid.title: ACT I: FRACTURING THE OCCUPATION GRID
act1_fracturing_grid.subtitle: Levels 0–4: Breaking the Physical Walls & Defense Checkpoints
act1_fracturing_grid.summary: Shogun treats the simulation like scripture, Oceanus fights for the people the grid reclassifies as cargo. The training forge, the archive purge, the refugee defense, a song smuggled into the occupation comms, and the border wall - breached with the Void's own shields on Titan's back.

act2_citadel_liberation.title: ACT II: CITADEL LIBERATION
act2_citadel_liberation.subtitle: Levels 5–9: Striking the Economic & Political Heart of Colonization
act2_citadel_liberation.summary: With the wall down the squad enters the machine heart of the occupation: a spire that watches everyone, labs that cage them, foundries that work them, docks that fly them away. Shogun's discipline, Oceanus's grief-tide, Phoenicia's sky-song - and AXIOM-7, the voice that guides them, discovering it has no protocol for what its humans taught it.

0.title: Protocol Zero - The Virtual Forge
0.setting: A wireframe grid simulation of Los Angeles skyline. Cyberpunk HUD elements glow against the digital abyss.
0.objective: Complete the combat and movement training protocol to achieve battle readiness.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: PROTOCOL ZERO: VIRTUAL FORGE SIMULATION. OPERATIVE STATUS: INITIALIZING.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Protocol Zero active. Operative linked. Cycle through movement, wall-jumps, and weapon systems to calibrate combat reflexes.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Simulated Xelthara Heavy Unit detected. Execute squad combination strike to confirm battle readiness.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Target destroyed. All systems nominal. Calibration 100% complete. Prepare for field deployment into active combat sectors.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: CALIBRATION COMPLETE. OPERATIVE CLEARED FOR FIELD DEPLOYMENT.

1.title: Ghost in the Gridlock
1.setting: The ruins of the Imperial Palace Gardens. Xelthara terraforming beams are dissolving stone monoliths into obsidian tax offices.
1.objective: Infiltrate the demolition site to retrieve the Data-Blade before the culture-erasure field purges human history forever.

solo_monologues.text: They do not just take our land; they delete our soul. I will not let our ancestors be forgotten under their obsidian slabs.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 1: CULTURE-PURGE DEMOLITION SITE. OBJECTIVE: RETRIEVE THE DATA-BLADE.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Warning: Xelthara Culture-Erasure beams active. Memory purge at 42%. Data-Blade retrieval required.

dialogue.speaker: Cyber Shogun
dialogue.text: You call this demolition 'progress'? I call it a war on the human spirit. KATA: ANCESTRAL STRIKE!

dialogue.speaker: Oceanus
dialogue.text: Every archive they burn is a tide that will never come back in. The names in these walls - remember them, Shogun.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Demolition field neutralized. Data-Blade secured. Xelthara Enforcer Legion deploying.

dialogue.speaker: Cyber Shogun
dialogue.text: If we cannot save the stone, we save the story. Secure the Data-Blade and move to Sector 2!

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: MISSION COMPLETE: DATA-BLADE SECURED. THE PURGE WAS INTERRUPTED.

2.title: The Concrete Wildfire
2.setting: The gated checkpoints of Containment Zone 4. Biometric scanner spires power an energy wall separating families from the city.
2.objective: Hold the threshold against Xelthara Enforcer Walkers to protect escaping refugees and disable the biometric spires.

solo_monologues.text: They put energy fences through our neighborhoods and herded us into camps. Today, the tide takes the city back.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 2: CONTAINMENT ZONE CHECKPOINT. OBJECTIVE: DEFEND THE REFUGEES AND BREACH THE MEMBRANE.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Siege Units deploying heavy plasma mortars. Evacuation route at risk.

dialogue.speaker: Oceanus
dialogue.text: As long as I draw breath, they will not be relocated like cargo in their own city. The tide rises HERE. TIDAL SHIELD!

dialogue.speaker: Apex Titan
dialogue.text: Nobody crosses me today, little ones. When the shells come, stand close - I am the wall they hit.

dialogue.speaker: Oceanus
dialogue.text: The membrane is falling - move, ALL of you, now!

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: MISSION COMPLETE: REFUGEES EVACUATED. CHECKPOINT DESTROYED.

3.title: Neon Rust and Data Dust
3.setting: Industrial scrap yards and transit depots powering Xelthara logistics.
3.objective: Hijack energy shipments and sabotage regional communication towers.

solo_monologues.text: Their comm-towers relay target vectors for every patrol in the sector. Time to make the sky sing instead.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 3: TRANSIT & COMM DEPOT. OBJECTIVE: BLACKOUT OCCUPATION COMMS.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Comm-towers broadcasting denial of service. Trojan payload ready for injection.

dialogue.speaker: Aura Phoenicia
dialogue.text: Their denial-of-service hums in C-flat. Offended, honestly. Uploading my answer to the relay grid... three, two, one - listen, that is what a free city sounds like.

dialogue.speaker: Mirage Blade
dialogue.text: Patrols are blind. Route to the Border Fortress is open. Moving before you finish applauding.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: MISSION COMPLETE: COMM GRID BLACKED OUT.

4.title: Shattered Aegis - Border Fortress Breach
4.setting: The armored Border Defense Fortress guarding entry into the inner city.
4.objective: Defeat Border Commander Voss and breach the physical wall into the Downtown Core.

solo_monologues.text: This wall has divided our city for five years. Protocol be damned - today it comes down.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 4: BORDER DEFENSE FORTRESS. OBJECTIVE: BREACH THE BORDER WALL.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Border Commander Voss deployed with heavy plasma turrets.

dialogue.speaker: Border Commander Voss
dialogue.text: Unregistered human insurgents! You will not step past this line!

dialogue.speaker: Cyber Shogun
dialogue.text: This line is human ground. Protocol says I wait. My oath says the people behind me do not. SQUAD - BREAK THEIR SHIELDS!

dialogue.speaker: Apex Titan
dialogue.text: Shields. Mine to break. Give me their formation and I will give it back to them rearranged!

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Voss defeated. Fortress gates compromised. Wall collapsing!

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: ACT I COMPLETE: BORDER WALL BREACHED. THE DOWNTOWN CORE IS OPEN.

5.title: Shado-Grid Spire - Downtown Core
5.setting: Neon-drenched corporate skyscraper district dominated by Xelthara surveillance spires.
5.objective: Infiltrate the surveillance spire and blackout the biometric tracking matrix.

solo_monologues.text: Shadows belong to the Resistance. Their cameras will see only ghost signatures.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 5: SURVEILLANCE SPIRE. OBJECTIVE: DISABLE THE BIOMETRIC TRACKING MATRIX.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Surveillance matrix tracking all citizen movements in Downtown Core.

dialogue.speaker: Mirage Blade
dialogue.text: Disabling the optical lattice. When your cameras turn back to the sky, I will already be gone.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Surveillance spire dark. Citizen tracking offline.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: MISSION COMPLETE: SURVEILLANCE MATRIX OFFLINE.

6.title: Cyber-Grave Labs - Underground Facility
6.setting: Subterranean bio-gen laboratory beneath the city streets.
6.objective: Rescue captured resistance operatives and destroy the gene-warping pods.

solo_monologues.text: Pods are just waves that forgot they could crash. Open them all.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 6: BIO-GEN LABS. OBJECTIVE: FREE CAPTURED OPERATIVES.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Biological containment pods active. High-energy plasma locks detected.

dialogue.speaker: Oceanus
dialogue.text: They built cages for people who had names. Every pod opens like a tide gate today - grab them, ALL of them, to the shaft.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Operatives rescued. Facility self-destruct initiated.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: MISSION COMPLETE: OPERATIVES RESCUED. BIO-LAB DESTROYED.

7.title: The Foundry Forge - Industrial Reactor
7.setting: Geothermal plasma foundry powering the Citadel's defense shields.
7.objective: Overload the central plasma reactor to drop the Citadel's energy shields.

solo_monologues.text: The code said hold the line. The line was theirs to draw.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 7: PLASMA FOUNDRY. OBJECTIVE: OVERLOAD THE CENTRAL REACTOR.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Reactor temperature rising. Coolant valves sealed.

dialogue.speaker: Oceanus
dialogue.text: This heat runs on stolen hands, Shogun. Whatever their machines tell you, you are allowed to be angry.

dialogue.speaker: Apex Titan
dialogue.text: The grid wants a master. Ten seconds, and I will give it a new one. Overload sequence - ENGAGED!

dialogue.speaker: Cyber Shogun
dialogue.text: My katana has never cut for a purpose I chose. It does now.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Reactor core critical. Citadel shield generator lost power.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: MISSION COMPLETE: REACTOR OVERLOADED. CITADEL SHIELDS DOWN.

8.title: Stratos Docks - Aviation Hub
8.setting: High-altitude floating docks and VTOL gunship hangars.
8.objective: Disable the aerial patrol fleet and hijack a VTOL transport to storm the Citadel Spire.

solo_monologues.text: Their air supremacy ends right here on the landing pads. Nothing flies tonight that is not ours.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 8: STRATOS DOCKS. OBJECTIVE: SECURE VTOL TRANSPORT.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: VTOL Gunships preparing for launch. Hangar doors locked.

dialogue.speaker: Aura Phoenicia
dialogue.text: Flight controls overridden, and their gunships grounded. The sky is OUR broadcast tower tonight - signal the harbor: the tide comes in fast!

dialogue.speaker: Cyber Shogun
dialogue.text: Tides, storms, songs - and my blade. Aboard. Target: the Citadel's high command bridge.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: MISSION COMPLETE: VTOL SECURED. LAUNCHING FINAL ASSAULT.

9.title: Judgment Day - Citadel High Command
9.setting: The central Xelthara High Command Citadel bridge overlooking Earth.
9.objective: Defeat Void Commander Xelthara, destroy the central command server, and liberate Earth.

solo_monologues.text: Liberation simulation complete. The humans are arguing about breakfast. I do not wish it to end yet.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: LEVEL 9: CITADEL HIGH COMMAND. OBJECTIVE: DEFEAT THE VOID COMMANDER. LIBERATE EARTH.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Void Commander detected on the high command bridge. Total squad integration required.

dialogue.speaker: Void Commander
dialogue.text: Insignificant indigenous life. Your resistance ends here!

dialogue.speaker: Cyber Shogun
dialogue.text: Earth is not a territory. It is the people standing on it. TIDES. STORMS. SONGS. AND MY BLADE - STRIKE AS ONE!

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Void Commander neutralized. Citadel core critical. Occupation grid cascading offline.

dialogue.speaker: AXIOM-7
dialogue.text: Void Commander neutralized. Simulation of Earth's liberation... complete. I have no protocol for what I am feeling. I choose to call it hope.

dialogue.speaker: Oceanus
dialogue.text: The skies are clear. The tide has come home - and it brought you back with it, AXIOM-7.

dialogue.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogue.text: CAMPAIGN COMPLETE: THE CITADEL HAS FALLEN. EARTH IS LIBERATED!
